name: ssu-saintbridge
description: Unofficial, local-first bridge for Soongsil University services

scripts.lint: eslint eslint.config.js vitest.config.ts test scripts --max-warnings 0 && pnpm -r --if-present run lint
scripts.test: vitest run scripts && pnpm -r --if-present run test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm security:check
